description: This file defines the EmployeeBenefitApplication class and related functions for managing employee benefit applications within an ERP system, including validation, benefit calculations, and database interactions.

classes.name: EmployeeBenefitApplication
classes.description: Represents an employee's benefit application, including validation and benefit calculation methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the benefit application before submission.

methods.name: validate_prev_benefit_claim
methods.description: Checks if previous benefit claims exceed allowed amounts.

methods.name: validate_remaining_benefit_amount
methods.description: Validates if the remaining benefit amount can be claimed based on salary structure.

methods.name: validate_max_benefit_for_component
methods.description: Ensures total benefit for components does not exceed maximum allowed.

methods.name: validate_max_benefit
methods.description: Checks if individual component benefit exceeds maximum limit.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_on_payroll_period
methods.description: Prevents duplicate applications for the same payroll period.
